title: Obtainable Bedrock
description: A modpack adding bedrock ore and bedrock tools.
body:
Adds a bedrock hoe, bedrock axe, bedrock pickaxe, bedrock shovel, and bedrock sword. To craft these new weapons you need to obtain bedrock by crafting bedrock ore. To craft bedrock ore you have to combine an emerald, a gold ingot, an iron ingot, a diamond, and a redstone block. Then you’ll get 3 bedrock ore. To make bedrock, combine 4 enchanted golden apples, 3 bedrock ore, and a netherite block. Then you’ll get 2 bedrock blocks.

For modrinth.
